text: Astronomy is the scientific discipline that examines the universe, encompassing all objects from the smallest subatomic particles to the largest galaxies. One of the most intriguing celestial entities is a nebula, which is a vast cloud of dust and gas that gives rise to stars and planets. To investigate these cosmic objects, astronomers employ sophisticated telescopes to take images of their expansive, distant environments. By capturing these images, we can appreciate the cosmic grandeur and complexity of the universe, and gain insight into the universal principles that shape it.
